meta.title: Notes & Todo
meta.description: A left-sidebar panel with two tabs. Notes you can edit and strike through, in whole or by the selected sentences. Todos backed by a user-defined field table (text, date, single select, multi select), with table, board and calendar views over the same records — each view setting its own columns, filters, sorts and grouping, plus subtasks and fuzzy search. Everything stays on this machine.
